layers.title: Causal World Model Layer
layers.purpose: Explain why market, broker, storage, auth, memory, backlog, launcher, and sleeve states changed before the system acts.

layers.title: Belief Ledger And Confidence Layer
layers.purpose: Attach confidence, freshness, uncertainty, regime fit, and evidence age to every decision surface.

layers.title: Digital Twin Replay Layer
layers.purpose: Compare current code, last-known-good code, and proposed policies against replay and shadow evidence before promotion.

layers.title: Adversarial Market And Infrastructure Simulator
layers.purpose: Stress market assumptions and infrastructure assumptions against bad ticks, queue floods, broker delays, route failures, and hostile liquidity.

layers.title: Self Scientific Method Layer
layers.purpose: Turn upgrades into hypotheses with expected benefit, evidence windows, proof artifacts, and rollback rules.

layers.title: Resource Economist Layer
layers.purpose: Allocate CPU, memory, disk, SQLite writes, training slots, paper slots, and operator attention by value and pressure.

layers.title: Promotion Court Layer
layers.purpose: Control collect-only to shadow to paper to live-read-only to live-eligible transitions with evidence gates.

layers.title: Living Ontology And System Memory Graph
layers.purpose: Maintain a searchable graph of bots, sleeves, launchers, reports, commands, drainers, trainers, guards, tickers, and dependencies.

layers.title: Operator Dialogue Layer
layers.purpose: Summarize what changed, what is blocked, what is safe next, and what needs human approval in plain operator language.

layers.title: Constitutional Risk Layer
layers.purpose: Enforce non-negotiable invariants that no model, bot, drainer, trainer, or launcher may override.
